mission: Make the current /wc fast-allocation path honor explicit contention-barrier metadata before any portfolio PIN attempt. Barrier-enabled multi-party canary jobs must allocate a timing-only entrant/rendezvous action first, wait only within the bounded barrier contract, then race the ordinary deterministic PIN after a valid RELEASE. Ordinary portfolio jobs must remain direct-to-PIN. Do not hardcode fixture job IDs and do not promote production /w.
